findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.botfriendly.xyz" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service, get_protocol_stats · Private data: submit_service · Public sink: submit_service · Destructive: check_site.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service, get_protocol_stats · Private data: submit_service · Public sink: submit_service · Destructive: check_site

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_categories" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List all BotFriendly categories with descriptions and service counts." → after: "List every BotFriendly category with its id (the search_services category value), human label, aliases (older slugs still accepted), description and service count."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
